Is BIMS Right for You?
Are you a purpose-driven, scientifically minded person who wants to make an impact in a bold and meaningful way? Are you looking for a student-centric graduate educational experience that produces innovative, creative, and career-ready scientists? Are you interested in medicine and research?
If you answered yes, then we want to connect to help you determine if the Biomedical Sciences (BIMS) Graduate Program at the Texas A&M College of Veterinary Medicine & Biomedical Sciences (VMBS) is right for you!
There are several opportunities to engage with us:
Submit this interest form (it’s short!) and we will get in touch with you.
Email our admissions & recruitment coordinator, Angela Degelman.
Schedule a one-on-one meeting with Angela.
Attend a recruitment event.
Angela Degelman
Coordinator for Recruitment & Admissions
BIMS Graduate Program, Research & Graduate Studies, VMBS
a-degelman@tamu.edu
979.845.1533

Recruitment Events
Doctoral Student Recruitment Weekend
Each year in February
After a preliminary holistic application review, the VMBS Graduate Admissions Committee selects a set of strong applicants to invite to the BIMS Doctoral Recruitment Weekend.
Activities include:
an interview with the admissions committee for consideration to the BIMS PhD Rotation Program
individual meetings with faculty who are seeking PhD students (to be admitted directly into their lab and/or rotate)
sessions with program administration to take you in depth into the program structure
tours of the College Station community
Applicants interested in being considered for this event:
may be pursuing admission that is direct (into a specific laboratory) or to the BIMS PhD Rotation Program
must have their application submitted by December 1, before the event in February
